purpose: One fresh source-to-measurement MATLAB trace and both-sign availability export under explicit default-support/observability assumptions. No C02 biological comparison.
selection_reason: First recording in the existing eight-source audit order; adds a 1200-frame / 2.35-micrometre C02 source to the existing ID400/HP workflow evidence. Not chosen for a desired biological result or claimed typical quality.
static_support: unchanged automatic default, explicitly unvalidated; draft polygon not adopted
frame_validity: leave undeclared; all modeled intervals retained, not asserted valid
configuration: Unchanged master defaults and 20-second clean pre-event baseline; normal master and stats entry points, fresh isolated source copy, no curated legacy MATs or AQuA2 results.

budget.memory: Measure process peak RSS and report its limits; historical 1200-frame HP process RSS was 12.52 GiB, not a total-machine guarantee. Check available resources before starting; do not alter scientific settings to fit memory.

required_outputs: Source checksum and captured acquisition declaration
Effective default settings and dictionary hash
Both-sign event registry, baseline reasons and measurement availability
Native mask union and both-sign area-time ingredients
First finite event trace per sign in saved row order, or explicit no-finite-event reason
One numerical replay per sign of source trace/baseline/amplitude/integral and occupancy where available
Unchanged source/implementation and preserved prior evidence checks
stop: After one successful descriptive workflow and numerical/source review. Preserve any failure; fix only a demonstrated execution defect. No automatic second mouse/state, mask adoption, exclusion, censoring change or contrast.

arithmetic_tolerance.meaning: Numerical replay only, not biological accuracy
